business_scope.primary_industry_name: International Bulk Export of Organic Dried Lycium and Herbal Botanicals

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - Sharia-informed civil-law-style statutory framework (Egyptian-influenced commercial codes) with common-law-inspired financial-sector regulation; unitary national legal system
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Oman-United States Free Trade Agreement (in force January 1, 2009)
EFTA States-Oman Free Trade Agreement (in force 2010)
GCC Economic Agreement / GCC Customs Union (2003)
Oman-Japan Double Taxation Avoidance Agreement (in force 2020)

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Royal Decree No. 30/2016 (Anti-Money Laundering and Combating the Financing of Terrorism Law) and its Executive Regulations, supplemented by Central Bank of Oman AML/CFT circulars and National Committee for Combating Money Laundering and Financing of Terrorism (NCCMLTF) binding guidance; Royal Decree No. 18/2019 (Commercial Companies Law), as amended by Royal Decree No. 106/2020; Ministerial Decision No. 13/2021 (Executive Regulations of the Commercial Companies Law), governing register of shareholders and beneficial owners; Commercial Register Law (Royal Decree No. 3/1974). Oman became a full FATF member in June 2023 and is a member of MENAFATF.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary Public in the UBO's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization (Oman is not a party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention; Arab League states may use the Arab League legalization agreement route)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization at the Omani Embassy/Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization at the Omani Embassy/Consulate

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization at the Omani Embassy/Consulate

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening of all UBOs (natural persons at or above the 25% threshold), directors and authorized signatories against: UN Security Council Consolidated Lists (1267/1989/2253, 1988 Taliban, 2231 Iran), OFAC SDN List (applied by Omani banks through USD correspondent clearing practice), UK HMT and EU consolidated lists, and the nationally gazetted terrorist list issued under RD 30/2016. PEP classification (foreign, domestic, international-organization) follows FATF Recommendations 12 and 22; enhanced due diligence, source-of-wealth evidence and senior-management approval are mandatory for PEP-linked UBOs. Transactions involving FATF grey/black-listed high-risk jurisdictions trigger enhanced measures and enhanced reporting to the National Centre for Financial Information (Omani FIU).

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Invest Easy - Electronic Commercial Registration and Licensing System, Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MOCIIP), https://investeasy.gov.om
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The official company name must be registered in Arabic. A foreign investor may adopt an Arabic transliteration of the foreign corporate name, with the English name recorded as a secondary transliteration only. The legal-form suffix 'Single Person Company' (Sharikat Al-Shakhs Al-Wahid / SPC) must be appended. Names containing Latin script alone are not accepted as the sole registered name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Names identical or deceptively similar to any existing Commercial Register entry or reserved trade name
References to the Sultan, the Royal Family, ministries, government bodies or the State emblem without prior written approval of MOCIIP
Tokens implying banking, finance, insurance, investment or securities activity without a prior license from the Central Bank of Oman or the Financial Services Authority
Words offensive to public order, Islamic morality or public taste
Names of international organizations such as UN, WTO, Red Cross/Red Crescent and similar protected emblems
Misleading geographic or origin descriptors (e.g., 'Swiss', 'National', 'International') absent case-by-case approval
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Name reservations are not automatically renewable; after expiry a fresh application must be filed through Invest Easy. On rejection, the applicant (through the registered agent) may file a written administrative appeal with the MOCIIP Undersecretary for Commercial Affairs within 30 days of the electronic refusal notice, attaching supporting evidence such as an active Omani trademark registration or written consent of the objecting party. Re-filing an amended name on Invest Easy without payment of a new fee is the standard fallback and generally avoids appeal delay.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permissible for this ISIC 4631 wholesale/export SPC as a registered correspondence address only, subject to municipal licensing in the 'business office' category and no on-site storage of dried botanicals. A physical premises becomes mandatory if the license is extended to warehousing, retail or food processing. The registered office must accept service of process and official gazette deliveries.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - approximately 8-12% annual probability of an unannounced inspection for a non-retail wholesale exporter under municipal and foodstuff hygiene rules; probability rises to approximately 25% if on-site storage of herbal botanicals is declared; MOCIIP corporate-file inspections are ordinarily documentary and triggered by complaint or targeted compliance campaigns.

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Commercial Companies Law of the Sultanate of Oman, Royal Decree No. 18/2019, Chapter on Single Person Companies (Articles 345-357), as amended by Royal Decree 91/2020 and complementary implementing regulations of the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion; read with the Commercial Register Regulation and the Foreign Capital Investment Law (RD 50/2019).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) - Commercial Registries General Directorate; one-stop electronic filing through the Invest Easy portal (investeasy.gov.om).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Memorandum and Articles of Association of the Single Person Company (SPC) (عقد التأسيس والنظام الأساسي), duly notarized and e-filed with the Commercial Registrar via Invest Easy.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital under RD 18/2019 for an SPC; capital must be adequate for the licensed activity and fully subscribed by the sole shareholder. No escrow account is mandated for foreign-owned wholesale entities; a bank certificate evidencing deposit of the capital contribution, or a licensed valuer's report for in-kind contributions, must accompany the incorporation filing.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: (1) That the sole shareholder subscribes to the entire authorised share capital of the Company, declared fully paid-up upon certification by the Company's bank in Oman; (2) That the registered office is established at the premises specified in the lease registered under Omani law, which shall serve as the Company's statutory address for service; (3) That [Name], [nationality], passport No. [ID], is appointed Manager and sole signatory with full authority to operate bank accounts, execute contracts, and represent the Company before all authorities; (4) That this resolution is effective upon issuance of the Commercial Register certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Trade Name Reservation and Activity Code Pre-Clearance
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Commercial Names Department via Invest Easy portal (investeasy.gov.om)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Register on Invest Easy using the shareholder's verified eID or passport; file a trade name reservation request selecting the SPC legal form and ISIC 4631 activity descriptor; provide at least three alternative names; upon successful uniqueness and Arabic-language eligibility screening, obtain the reservation certificate valid for 60 days, which is a precondition to incorporation filing.
required_dossiers: Three proposed trade names (Arabic and transliterated English)
Signed declaration of no prior identical name
Power of attorney if filed through a licensed agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a name is rejected, file an administrative objection with the Director of Commercial Names within 15 days; simultaneously submit Alternative 2 or 3 from the submission list; a re-search fee waiver applies where rejection is caused by registry database error.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Notarization and E-Filing of the SPC Memorandum and Articles of Association
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Notary Public Department of the Governorate First Instance Court, then MoCIIP Registrar of Companies via Invest Easy
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and notarize the SPC's MOA/AOA in Arabic before the competent notary; ensure the objects clause covers bulk wholesale and export of dried Lycium berries, herbal botanicals, and related foodstuffs; upload the notarized deed, name reservation certificate, capital certificate, and lease to Invest Easy; pay the prescribed fee and obtain the electronic approval notice referencing the provisional Commercial Register number.
required_dossiers: Sole shareholder passport and any corporate shareholder documents
Lease agreement or title deed for registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: On a registry clarification query, cure the flagged article or supporting document within 10 working days through the Invest Easy comment module; non-response triggers deemed withdrawal with a 50% fee refund; a fresh filing is permitted after amending the deficient clause.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Commercial Register Entry and Tax/Social Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: MoCIIP Commercial Registries; Oman Tax Authority (OTA); Social Protection Fund (formerly PASI)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon final approval, the SPC is entered into the Commercial Register and the CR certificate and company card are issued; concurrently apply online to the Oman Tax Authority for Corporate Income Tax registration (mandatory regardless of income), with VAT registration at the mandatory threshold when taxable supplies exceed OMR 38,500 per annum; register as employer with the Social Protection Fund once hiring commences.
required_dossiers: Shareholder passport and CR of corporate shareholder (if applicable)
Bank account opening confirmation for capital deposit
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the CR record contains an ISIC, address, or capital mismatch, request a rectification order via Invest Easy within 7 days without re-notarization; OTA registration objections are resolved through the OTA e-services amendment flow, with a statutory reassessment period of 5 working days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Municipal Commercial Operating License for Wholesale Premises
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Muscat Municipality or the competent Governorate Municipality, through the Invest Easy Municipality Window
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit the registered lease, CR, and civil defense preliminary fire approval; complete the municipal inspection questionnaire identifying the premises as warehouse and administrative office for wholesale of dried fruits and botanicals; after successful physical inspection, obtain the annual Commercial Operating License (تصريح مزاولة النشاط) reflecting the activity 'wholesale trade of dried foodstuffs and herbal botanicals'.
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the license is refused on zoning or structural grounds, apply to the Municipality Direct Investment Services Committee for an alternative approved location within 30 days; denials of the inspection report may be grieved within 10 working days and trigger a second physical inspection at no additional cost.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Chamber of Commerce Enrollment and Record Stamping
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) - Muscat Branch
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Enroll the SPC with OCCI within 30 days of CR issuance to obtain the Chamber membership certificate and stamp on the CR and MOA; membership attests commercial standing and is mandatory for customs declarations, export certificates, and letters of credit related to cross-border goji berry and botanical consignments; renew annually by payment of the subscription computed on capital class.
required_dossiers: Commercial Register certificate and company card
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Failure to enroll within 30 days triggers a late fee per OCCI bylaws; classification disputes are appealable to the OCCI Membership Committee; a reduced subscription may be obtained upon submission of the SME Development Authority (Riyada) certification, which classifies the SPC as a micro or small enterprise.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Oman Food and Drug Authority (OFDA) - Food Establishments and Export Licensing Directorate, acting with the Ministry of Agriculture, Fisheries and Water Resources (MAFWR) Plant Protection Directorate for phytosanitary certification, and the local Municipality for premises licensing.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Food Business Establishment Registration Certificate for Wholesale Export of Dried Fruits and Herbal Botanicals, together with an OFDA Export Conformity Certificate and a MAFWR Phytosanitary Certificate issued per ISPM 7 for each consignment of Lycium berries and herbal botanicals.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Environment Authority (EA) of the Sultanate of Oman, operating under Royal Decree 114/2001 on Environmental Impact Assessment and the 2019 Environmental Permitting Regulations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Category 2 - Environmental Screening and Preliminary Environmental Review: bulk storage, grading, and repackaging of dried botanicals without industrial processing is a low-impact activity requiring only an Environmental Permit and annual self-monitoring report; a Category 1 Full EIA Study is not triggered absent wastewater-intensive washing lines, fuel-burning dryers, or effluent discharge above 20 m2 per day.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: Zero process wastewater for dry-goods handling; where periodic wash-down occurs, discharge to public sewer must not exceed BOD5 300 mg/L, COD 500 mg/L, TSS 300 mg/L, and oils and grease 100 mg/L with pH 6.5-8.5; dust control through sealed ventilation with particulate matter not exceeding 150 mg/Nm3 at any exhaust point; no VOC-emitting solvent operations in the packing hall; solid non-hazardous waste segregated and delivered to licensed municipal transfer stations; pest-control fumigants stored in secondary-containment cabinets; environmental records retained for 5 years and submitted to the EA on annual request.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: CDAA (Civil Defence and Ambulance Authority of the Royal Oman Police) fire safety certificate: egress dimensions verified, emergency lighting and signage installed, portable extinguishers positioned at a minimum ratio of one per 200 m2, and staff fire-drill logs maintained; structural load certificate issued by a licensed civil engineer confirming floor and racking loads; municipal occupational clearance certifying workplace sanitation, ventilation, washroom facilities, and compliance with the Occupational Health and Safety duties of the Labour Code (RD 14/2006, as amended).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Secretariat General of Taxation (SGT), Ministry of Finance, Sultanate of Oman; official national portal: Oman Tax Portal (https://taxes.gov.om)
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: For a foreign-owned Omani SPC the following sequence applies: (1) Obtain the Commercial Registration (CR) certificate from the Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) after notarizing the Notarial Deed and Articles of Association; (2) Register on the Oman Tax Portal and validate the CR; (3) File the electronic tax registration application, selecting 'juridical person (Single Person Company)' as the entity class and 'wholesale trade of herbal botanicals / ISIC 4631' as the activity; (4) Upload supporting documents: CR certificate, constitutional documents, registered-office address proof, passport and residency documentation of the sole foreign shareholder, appointment documents of the manager and auditor, and a power of attorney to a licensed tax representative, if any; (5) The SGT issues the official Tax Identification Number (TIN) for income tax and, where the OMR 38,500 VAT registration threshold is met or expected to be met, a separate VAT Registration Number (VRN); (6) Activate e-filing credentials and the e-invoicing connection. Typical processing time is 5-15 business days from submission of a complete file; late registration subjects the SPC to fixed administrative fines under the VAT and income tax laws.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.default_entity_tax_classification: Entity_Level_Taxation - The Omani SPC is a resident juridical person and a separate taxable entity under Royal Decree No. 56/2023 (Oman Income Tax Law, effective for tax periods beginning on or after 1 January 2024). It is taxed at entity level on worldwide taxable profits; the sole foreign shareholder is not assessed on the SPC's profits at the shareholder level in Oman. Oman does not provide partnership pass-through or subchapter-S style classification; there is no US-style check-the-box election. Small-enterprise tax relief and the standard Omani corporate tax rate apply based on taxable income, and dividends distributed to a non-resident shareholder are generally free of Omani withholding tax.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No US-style check-the-box election is recognized by Omani law; tax classification follows the Commercial Companies Law. Available statutory elections include: (i) adoption of a fiscal year different from the calendar year with SGT approval; (ii) utilization of carried-forward tax losses within the statutory five-year window; (iii) VAT group registration election for related Omani entities satisfying the 100% ownership and control conditions; (iv) voluntary VAT registration election at the OMR 19,250 threshold; (v) advance pricing arrangement and mutual agreement procedure applications; and (vi) depreciation and amortization policy elections in the CIT return. No hybrid-mismatch entity election is currently available in Oman.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) under the GCC Unified VAT Agreement, implemented in Oman by Royal Decree No. 121/2020 and the Executive Regulations (Ministerial Decision No. 53/2021)
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Mandatory VAT registration: OMR 38,500 of annual taxable supplies and imports measured over the preceding 12 months or expected over the next 12 months; Voluntary VAT registration: OMR 19,250
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Oman is implementing a nationally mandated e-invoicing regime through the SGT digital infrastructure. Taxable persons must issue structured electronic VAT invoices (JSON/XML) through SGT-approved, API-connected invoicing systems; real-time fiscal pre-clearance and digital stamping are being phased in, with initial mandatory phases applying to large taxpayers. Every tax invoice must contain the mandated line-item data fields, the seller's and buyer's VAT registration numbers, the applicable tax rates, and a QR code. Invoices not compliant with the e-invoicing format may be denied as evidence for input VAT deduction and expose the issuer to administrative penalties.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to supplies of goods, including dried goji berries and herbal botanicals, that are physically exported outside the GCC territory. Conditions: (i) the goods are sold to a customer outside the GCC; (ii) the goods are dispatched and leave Oman within 90 days from the date of supply/invoice; (iii) the export movement is evidenced by an electronic customs export declaration; (iv) the exporter retains transport and delivery documentation such as a Bill of Lading showing an Omani load port and a non-GCC destination; and (v) the export proceeds are received through an Omani licensed bank and repatriated pursuant to Central Bank of Oman exchange-control deadlines. Input VAT incurred on purchases attributable to zero-rated exports is creditable and recoverable through the VAT return and refund process.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Oman electronic customs export declaration (Arabian Gulf Customs System / AFAL clearance record)
Commercial invoice and zero-rated VAT tax invoice issued in accordance with the Oman VAT Law
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export from Oman to a non-GCC destination, with container and seal numbers
Packing list and certificate of origin for the dried goji berry / herbal botanical consignment
Inward Remittance Certificate or SWIFT MT103 credit advice from an Omani licensed bank evidencing receipt of export proceeds in foreign currency
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: The SGT and the Royal Oman Police Customs Directorate jointly audit export supply chains through AFAL trade-data matching, banking records, VAT returns, and corporate filings. If goods do not physically leave Oman within 90 days, or if required documentation is missing or false, the zero-rating is reversed and VAT is assessed at 5% on the supply together with statutory late-payment penalties and administrative fines. Deliberate fraudulent zero-rating, including fictitious export documents, circular shipments, or false declarations of destination, constitutes tax evasion and may lead to clawback of any VAT refunds paid, criminal fines, and imprisonment in serious cases. Exporters should also expect periodic SGT audits requiring submission of the customs bundle, transport contracts, insurance certificates, and bank credit advices to substantiate each zero-rated export consignment.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Central Bank of Oman (CBO; البنك المركزي العماني), Muscat. Established by Royal Decree No. 4/1974; sole licensing, supervision and resolution authority for banks, exchange houses and payment-service providers under the Banking Law (Royal Decree No. 114/2000) and the Foreign Exchange Law (Royal Decree No. 38/1996). The CBO administers the OMR/USD peg, operates the national RTGS and OMR clearing infrastructure, and collects cross-border transaction classification data from licensed banks for balance-of-payments statistics.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The Omani Rial is fully convertible on both current account and capital account. The OMR is pegged at a fixed central rate of 1 OMR = 2.6008 USD (1 USD = 0.3845 OMR) with only a narrow dealing spread, so no material FX conversion risk attaches to USD-priced goji berry export receivables. CBO imposes no exchange-control licence, prior approval, or repatriation permit for equity injections, shareholder loans, dividend distributions, profit remittances, or supplier payments. Profit-remittance hurdles are purely documentary: the remitting bank verifies the SPC's valid Commercial Registration, Tax Card and tax good-standing, audited or management-account evidence of distributable profit, and a clear purpose narrative in the SWIFT instruction.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender, conversion timeline, or mandatory conversion ratio applies to export receipts under Royal Decree 38/1996. The SPC may retain 100% of USD, EUR, GBP, or CNY export proceeds indefinitely in CBO-licensed foreign-currency accounts; conversion to OMR, when required, is executed at the commercial bank's published spot rate. All export proceeds must enter through the licensed banking system, be classified on the bank's balance-of-payments reporting as 'export proceeds of goods', and be reconcilable to Oman Customs single-window declarations and shipping documents.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.capital_repatriation_and_distribution_ru: No CBO approval is required for outward dividend or capital repatriation. The bank conducts a standard trade-and-tax review requiring: (1) an up-to-date Tax Card; (2) absence of unsettled tax assessment or tax-avoidance notice; (3) shareholder resolution of the SPC authorising distribution; (4) audited financial statements showing realised profits; and (5) proof that all inbound share-capital contributions were correctly recorded as equity or shareholder loans at the time of receipt. Remittances are executed via SWIFT MT103 with purpose narrative stating 'dividend distribution' or 'capital repatriation' and the relevant CR number.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account: single OMR current account with multi-currency sub-ledgers (USD/EUR/GBP) serving as the initial share-capital custody account and day-to-day export-collection and supplier-disbursement account; bank's trade desk supports LC, MT103 and packing-loan facilities.

Capital Escrow Account / Operational Account: OMR and multi-currency current accounts; global account-opening referral available for the non-resident UBO who is an existing HSBC customer overseas; strongest international clearing and FX-treasury desk for an export-oriented SPC.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual audited financial statements, auditor's report, and sole member approval minutes (statutory deposit)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Ministry of Commerce, Industry and Investment Promotion (MoCIIP) — Commercial Registration Directorate via Sijilat
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: FYE 31 Dec; sole member approval by 30 Apr; MoCIIP deposit no later than 30 Jun
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: MoCIIP fines of OMR 10–100 per violation; CR suspension for overdue filings; administrative strike-off after 12 months of persistent default.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Commercial Register confirmation (annual return of registered particulars)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 January under the Sijilat calendar-year renewal cycle
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late fee of OMR 5–25 per month; blocking of CR certificates and trade license renewal; administrative deregistration after 6 months of inactive record.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Beneficial Ownership Register annual confirmation (UBO data verification and shareholding updates)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually by 31 January; mandatory update within 60 days of any shareholder or UBO change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Fine of OMR 1,000–2,000 under MoCIIP Decision 20/2019; share transfers and CR transactions suspended until the register is accurate.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual municipal commercial license renewal for wholesale botanical trading premises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Muscat Municipality (or relevant governorate municipality) via Sijilat one-stop
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Renewal by 31 December for the succeeding calendar year; Muscat renewal window includes a 1–31 January grace period
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Daily penalty of OMR 10–50; business closure order; removal from commercial registry if unpaid beyond 3 months.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) annual subscription and company data revalidation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Oman Chamber of Commerce and Industry (OCCI) — Muscat branch
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Due by 31 January each calendar year
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Inability to attest import/export certificates, CR extracts, and agency agreements; OCCI clearance blocked for subsequent government transactions.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No revenue or asset threshold: every Omani commercial company, including a 100% foreign-owned SPC, must appoint an auditor from the MoCIIP register and produce audited annual financial statements under Royal Decree 18/2019 (Commercial Companies Law); the sole member cannot waive the audit.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: Full IFRS as issued by the IASB, applied per Omani Commercial Companies Law (RD 18/2019); IFRS for SMEs acceptable for non-listed wholesale SPCs.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Shareholding changes are effective only after MoCIIP register update; the SPC must file UBO particulars within 60 days of any change and re-confirm the register annually by 31 January. The auditor reviews the statutory registers during the year-end engagement and reports discrepancies to MoCIIP.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 400 – 1,100 per annum for the registered address, corporate agent, and PO box arrangement
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 650 – 1,600 per annum for a licensed Omani auditor (fee scales with banking transaction volume)

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Qualifying SME rate of 3% on taxable income up to OMR 100,000 (15% on excess). No automatic export tax holiday for mainland wholesale traders; a discretionary 5-year income tax holiday may be granted by the Investment Authority for strategic projects; free-zone licensed entities (e.g., Duqm SEZ) may enjoy exemption periods of up to 30 years. No sub-national corporate income tax exists in Oman.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Oman Tax Authority (OTA) e-Services portal at taxoman.gov.om - official designation 'Income Tax Return' (corporate self-assessment return) filed electronically under the SPC tax file; paper return permitted only with OTA derogation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The return must be filed within 6 months after the end of the tax year (the tax year is the financial year, normally 1 January to 31 December unless a different accounting period is pre-approved). Final tax is payable on the filing date; the OTA may grant up to a 3-month extension if applied for before the due date.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Gross worldwide turnover from the bulk wholesale of dried goji berries and herbal botanicals (ISIC 4631).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Report all documented sales via Swift TT and wire transfers; export proceeds must be traceable to the SPC's Omani bank statements to avoid classification as unreported offshore income.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Any incidental income from storage, handling, commission, or logistics fees earned in Oman.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Oman-source service fees are taxable even when invoiced to a foreign customer; apportionment is not permitted for a resident SPC.
This figure must reconcile with bank inflows and e-invoicing records; unexplained deposits are a red flag for the OTA.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 4 - Purchases / cost of goods sold
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Actual cost of dried lycium, herbal botanicals, packaging, inbound freight, and import duties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Support each cost with supplier contracts, customs declarations, and warehouse receipts; use CUP benchmarking for goji berry purchase prices.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Salaries, statutory PIASI social security contributions, and benefits of SPC staff.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Payments to the foreign shareholder or associated persons are deductible only under a documented employment or service structure with real substance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax depreciation computed on OTA-accepted rates; book and tax depreciation must be reconciled.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the SPC prepares IFRS financial statements, add back book depreciation and substitute the tax depreciation schedule.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Marketing, organic/HACCP certification, legal, professional fees, insurance, and TP documentation costs.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-deductible items include gratuitous management fees, entertainment costs, fines, tax penalties, and capital expenditures.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 8 - Adjusted taxable profit before reliefs
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Line 3 minus deductible expenses adjusted for permanent and temporary differences.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Related-party charges must meet the arm's-length standard; round-tripping of funds through a foreign parent is recharacterised as a distribution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Offset of unabsorbed tax losses from prior years (maximum 5-year carryforward).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A change in the SPC's ownership or business activity may extinguish the loss carryforward; document the continuity of the trade.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax base remaining after loss relief.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Apply the 3% SME rate only if taxable income does not exceed OMR 100,000 and the SPC qualifies as a registered SME; otherwise apply 15%.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Tax computed at the applicable statutory rate.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The SPC pays tax on its profits; the distribution of dividends is not deductible and the withholding obligation arises separately at distribution.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Line 12 - Foreign tax credits / advance payments
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Credit for foreign taxes borne on foreign-source income and any payments on account made to the OTA.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The FTC is limited to the Omani tax attributable to the same foreign-source income and cannot generate a refund.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Final balance payable with the return or the amount to be refunded.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Pay via OTA e-payment (SAAD/credit transfer) and retain proof; late payment triggers monthly surcharges.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing: OMR 100 fixed fine plus OMR 25 per month of delay up to a maximum of OMR 1,000. Late payment: monthly surcharge on outstanding tax capped at 2% per month. Understatement: up to 25% additional penalty on the extra tax assessed. Failure to maintain records: OMR 500. Persistent non-filing beyond 12 months exposes the SPC to a 10% discretionary assessment, licence cancellation, and loss of treaty relief protections.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: OTA e-filing annexure - 'Related-Party Transactions and Transfer Pricing Schedule' (TP declaration embedded in the annual corporate income tax return).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Submitted together with the corporate income tax return within 6 months of the tax year-end; contemporaneous Local File and Master File must be finalised by the filing deadline even though they are produced to the OTA only on request.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Identification of the foreign sole shareholder, upstream affiliates, and any Omani related companies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Disclose ultimate beneficial ownership of the parent; nominee shareholders and trusts must be fully identified for OTA and AML screening.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Contract values of purchases and sales of dried goji berries and herbal stock, management fees, royalties, and interest with related parties.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Select the OECD-approved arm's-length method applied (e.g., CUP or TNMM) and retain comparability evidence and functional analysis.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-submission of the TP schedule is treated as non-filing with fines of OMR 100 to OMR 1,000; absent contemporaneous documentation, the OTA may impose a 25% additional assessment penalty on the arm's-length adjustment and deny double-tax relief.
